channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Empate impõe aos candidatos comparecimento aos debates
item.description: After initially stating he would not attend the Band debate, Flávio Bolsonaro decided to participate in the showdown with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on Sunday. He attributed the change of stance to a supposed strategy by Lula to force his attendance, though the explanation is questioned as contrived. The candidate had seriously considered not debating, planning to only participate in the Globo debate, the eve of the second round.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 46% e Lula soma 44% no 2º turno, mostra pesquisa Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll reveals a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (44%) in the presidential runoff. The PL senator leads numerically but remains within the margin of error. Survey released on October 14, 2024.

item.title: Quaest: No 2º turno, Flávio tem 46% dos votos totais, contra 44% de Lula em empate técnico
item.description: The first Quaest poll for the 2026 runoff shows senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 46% of voter intent, against 44% for President Lula (PT). With a 2-point margin of error, both candidates are in a technical tie. The poll was released on Wednesday, the 14th, reflecting a tight race for the decisive election.

item.title: PSD vai ao STF para restabelecer segundo turno no Rio
item.description: The PSD filed a fundamental precept violation action (ADPF) at the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to restore the second round of the gubernatorial election in Rio de Janeiro, after Douglas Ruas was confirmed as the elected governor. The move seeks to challenge the electoral court's decision to recount votes and confirm the candidate's victory.

item.title: Como estão as rejeições a Lula e a Flávio no segundo turno, segundo a Quaest
item.description: A Genial/Quaest poll shows 54% of respondents would not vote for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), while 53% reject Lula (PT). However, 46% indicate support for Flávio, compared to 44% for Lula. The survey was conducted from October 10-13 with a 2-point error margin.

item.title: Câmara vota pacote de Lula para MEIs no mesmo dia em que Senado decide 6×1
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies will vote on Wednesday a package of benefits from the Lula government for MEIs, including an increase in the revenue ceiling and tax debt forgiveness. The main project is PL 186/26, which already has a rapporteur. The vote takes place simultaneously with the Senate decision on the PEC that ends the 6×1 scale.

item.title: Durante votação do fim da 6 X 1, Lula se reúne com senadores do MDB
item.description: President Lula meets with MDB senators during the voting of the PEC ending the 6 X 1 scale, seeking support for pension reform. Although convened by Lula, the meeting is organized by Senator Eduardo Braga, with the presence of figures such as Camilo Santana and Marcelo Castro.

item.title: Campanha de Lula aciona TSE contra Meta e questiona alcance de vídeos de Nikolas e ferramenta de IA
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE accusing Meta of limiting the reach of posts by the candidate and his supporters, while content from allies of Flávio Bolsonaro, such as Nikolas Ferreira, allegedly received inflated distribution without justification. The coalition questions whether the platform applies selective content distribution and demands an investigation into the disproportionate reach of political videos.

item.title: Guimarães diz que Flávio Bolsonaro "fez o L" ao apoiar fim da escala 6x1
item.description: Minister José Guimarães (PT) claimed President Lula pressured Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to support ending the 6x1 work schedule, accusing the candidate of 'following L' due to popular pressure. Guimarães labeled Flávio's support as 'empty talk', suggesting PL aims to reverse the amendment in 2027 if elected. The Senate votes today on the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 schedule, proposed by Lula with reduction to 40 weekly hours.

item.title: OEA será acionada por Lula sobre interferência da Meta nas eleições
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a complaint with the OAS against Meta over alleged interference in the 2026 elections following restrictions on content delivery across social media platforms. Camilo Santana stated that the company did not respond to requests for comment and that the matter was also brought before the TSE.

item.title: STF cobra cumprimento de acesso gratuito a sites da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: STF minister Cristiano Zanin ordered Anatel to investigate failures in free access to Electoral Justice websites following complaints during the first round of elections. The measure ensures voters with exhausted data limits can access essential voting and misinformation check information. Zanin gave Anatel 48 hours to explain the causes of failures in services like e-Título and Pardal.

item.title: Quaest: medo de reeleição de Lula empata com medo de volta dos Bolsonaro
item.description: Quaest survey reveals 43% of Brazilians fear Lula's reelection and 43% fear the return of the Bolsonaro family, with a technical tie in the second round between Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) and Lula (44%). Main fears about Lula center on corruption and economy, while fears about Bolsonaros involve authoritarianism and loss of rights.

item.title: Ministro de Lula diz não ter dúvidas de interferência dos EUA na eleição
item.description: Brazil's communication minister states there are no doubts about U.S. interference in the electoral process, accusing the country of directly influencing the election. Lula's campaign intensifies complaints against Meta, claiming biased treatment favoring Flávio Bolsonaro's content, and announces plans to bring the case to the OAS. The party also filed lawsuits alleging technical issues affecting reach of their digital content.

item.title: Flávio aciona TSE por apoio de sindicatos a Lula e quer cassar chapa rival
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE seeking to prevent unions and the UNE from supporting Lula and Alckmin, alleging electoral law violations. The complaint asks for the annulment of Lula and Alckmin's candidacies and disqualification of union leaders and social leaders for allegedly breaching campaign finance rules. The case references a joint statement signed by major unions after the first round.

item.title: Quaest: 73% dizem que votam em Lula por ele ser o melhor candidato; e 53% votam em Flávio Bolsonaro pelo mesmo motivo
item.description: A Quaest poll released on October 14 shows that 73% of Lula's voters chose him because they consider him the best candidate, while 53% of Flávio Bolsonaro's voters supported him for the same reason. The survey indicates 46% voting intentions for Flávio Bolsonaro against 44% for Lula in the second round, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Quaest: proibir bets, fim da escala 6x1 e reduzir maioridade penal lideram entre propostas mais aprovadas pelos eleitores
item.description: A Quaest survey shows that proposals by Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula regarding the ban on betting sites, the end of the 6-to-1 ratio, and the reduction of the age of criminal responsibility lead among the most approved by voters. The poll evaluated nine topics, including taxes on the basic basket and minimum wage above inflation. Voters showed high approval (61-64%) for banning online betting, ending the 6-to-1 ratio, and reducing the age of criminal responsibility.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Wilson Grassi anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: Wilson Grassi, a defeated presidential candidate from the Democrata party, endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro for the runoff, rejecting Lula. However, he sent a letter with five commitments to protect animals, demanding specific public policies.

item.title: Flávio tem 46% e Lula tem 44% no 2º turno, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest survey released on October 14, 2026, shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 46% of second-round voting intentions against Lula (PT), who recorded 44%, with both candidates technically tied within the margin of error. The survey, conducted between October 10 and 13 with 2,154 voters, has a margin of error of ±2 percentage points and was filed with the TSE under protocol BR-08729/2026.

item.title: Flávio promete retomar obras contra enchentes no RS caso eleito
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro promised to resume flood control works in Rio Grande do Sul and criticized Lula for not fulfilling promises made after the 2024 floods. During a visit to the Sarandi neighborhood in Porto Alegre, he also listed commitments such as funding for farmers and expansion of the railway network.

item.title: TSE manda Pablo Marçal apagar vídeo manipulado de Lula em até 3 horas
item.description: The TSE ordered Pablo Marçal to remove a manipulated video of President Lula within 3 hours, with a daily fine of BRL 10,000 for Meta, for taking statements about religion out of context. The Brazil Ready for More coalition filed a lawsuit against Marçal and Flávio Bolsonaro, but Minister André Mendonça cleared Flávio of responsibility, assigning the post solely to Marçal.

item.title: Petista, governador da Bahia amplia transporte gratuito no 2º turno
item.description: The government of Bahia, led by Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT), expanded free transportation for voters in the second round of the 2026 elections, responding to a request from mayors and aiming to reduce voter abstention. The measure benefits various means of transport, including intermunicipal buses, ferry-boats, small boats, metropolitan transport, and metro, with free periods varying by service. This initiative is part of PT's strategy to try to reverse Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) advantage in the second round, scheduled for October 25th.

item.title: Eduardo Paes abre nova frente no STF para tentar realização de 2º turno no RJ
item.description: The PSD filed a motion with the STF requesting a runoff in the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial race between Douglas Ruas (PL) and Eduardo Paes (PSD). The move aims to ensure the continuation of the state electoral process amid potential legal challenges.

item.title: Quaest mostra empate técnico entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula a 11 dias do 2º turno
item.description: Quaest poll shows technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) and Lula (44%) 11 days before runoff. Margin of error is two percentage points.

item.title: Quaest: Flávio Bolsonaro marca 46%, e Lula tem 44% no 2º turno
item.description: Quaest poll for 2026 elections shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 46% and Lula (PT) at 44% in the second round, within the statistical tie margin. The survey was released on October 14th.

item.title: Quaest: Flávio tem 46% e Lula, 44%
item.description: A Quaest survey released on November 14 shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), with 46% and 44% respectively in a hypothetical second round. The two-point margin of error means both candidates are statistically tied. Blank and null votes account for 9% of voting intention.

item.title: A primeira pesquisa Quaest sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula no segundo turno
item.description: The first Quaest poll after the first round shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (44%), with 9% blank votes and 1% undecided. Flávio leads in voting intentions, but the difference is within the two percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Quaest: 48% desaprovam governo Lula e 45% aprovam
item.description: The latest Quaest poll shows 48% disapproval and 45% approval for President Lula's government, with a margin of error of two percentage points. The survey, commissioned by Globo and O Globo, interviewed 2,154 respondents between October 10 and 13, 2026.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: Flávio tem 46% e Lula 44% no segundo turno
item.description: A Quaest poll released on October 14 shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 46% of total voting intentions, against 44% for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Among valid votes only, Flávio leads with 51% and Lula with 49%. Both candidates have high rejection rates, at 54% and 53% respectively.

item.title: Quaest, 2º turno: Flávio Bolsonaro, 46%; Lula, 44%
item.description: A Quaest poll released Wednesday shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 46% and Lula (PT) at 44% in the second round. Both are within the two-point margin of error, with 91% of voters saying their choice is final. Rejection rates are similar: 54% would not vote for Flávio and 53% for Lula.

item.title: Em áudio, Gayer demonstra preocupação com mobilização do PT nas ruas
item.description: Federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) released an audio alert expressing concern over the mobilization of supporters of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the streets and its influence on internal polling for Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, highlighting a 'risk situation' and calling for 'total engagement' in the final 12 days before the runoff.

item.title: O que dizem eleitores que trocaram Lula por Flávio Bolsonaro em 2026: 'Numa cidade do agro, mudei minha mentalidade'
item.description: Voters in São Luís and Balsas, Maranhão, shifted from supporting Lula's PT to backing Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in 2026, driven by a mindset change tied to the local agribusiness environment and the emphasis on individual merit. This trend reduced Lula's vote share in 25 of Brazil's 27 states, particularly in areas connected to the agricultural sector.

item.title: O plano para salvar Alexandre de Moraes se Flávio Bolsonaro ganhar a eleição
item.description: Michel Temer emerged in the election supporting Flávio Bolsonaro, allegedly to protect Alexandre de Moraes from potential impeachment. This move comes after years of conflict between the Supreme Court and Bolsonaro's allies.

item.title: The Strokes, Tom Morello e Oliver Sykes: nomes da música internacional declaram apoio a Lula
item.description: International artists such as The Strokes, Tom Morello, and Oliver Sykes voiced support for Lula's reelection, underscoring the role of culture in Brazilian politics. The American band The Strokes posted digital artwork supporting Lula, generating significant engagement on Instagram, while Tom Morello also declared his support, reinforcing the political involvement of cultural figures in the election.

item.title: Mendonça nega pedido do PT para PL apagar vídeo sobre Lula
item.description: Supreme Electoral Court Minister André Mendonça denied the PT's request for the PL to remove a video linking former President Lula to individuals investigated for fraud in INSS union discounts. The decision keeps the post made by the PL party, led by Flávio Bolsonaro, online. The petitioners considered the information in the post inaccurate.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e aliados querem incluir redução da maioridade penal em PEC da Segurança Pública
item.description: PL senators and opponents of President Lula propose an amendment to the Public Security Constitutional Amendment Bill (PEC) lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 years (14 for heinous crimes). The amendment, signed by Flávio Bolsonaro and Rogério Marinho, aims to prosecute minors to combat organized crime, despite the original PEC not addressing the issue.

item.title: Nunes Marques recorre a artifícios que criticava e amplia tensão no TSE
item.description: Nunes Marques, head of the TSE, employed tactics he previously criticized, sparking backlash over alleged favoritism toward Flávio Bolsonaro. The suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel was overturned by the attorney general, yet Marques pushed for continued oversight, fueling institutional tension.

item.title: Mendonça derruba vídeo de Janones que associa Flávio a plano falso de reduzir aposentadorias
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of a video by Federal Deputy André Janones, which falsely linked Flávio Bolsonaro to a plan to reduce pensions. Mendonça stated there are no statements or proposals from the candidate to this effect, emphasizing his commitment to maintaining the link between minimum wage and pension benefits.

item.title: A postura de Motta que chamou a atenção de base e oposição às vésperas do segundo turno
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber, avoided voting on controversial measures before the runoff to not favor Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro, prioritizing his reelection with support from center and left-wing parties. He aims to isolate the PL and replicate Arthur Lira's 2023 strategy.

item.title: IA do WhatsApp também se recusa a gerar imagem de candidato do PT no DF
item.description: Meta's AI assistant refused to generate images of candidates such as Leandro Grass (PT) and Lula, while allowing those of others, like Celina Leão (PP) and Flávio Bolsonaro. The company stated it follows Brazilian electoral rules, temporarily blocking image generation and recommendations of candidates, but delays exist in applying this policy to all names. The differential treatment may be linked to a gradual update of restrictions across the tool.

item.title: Apoiar a indústria de jogos é apoiar a criatividade brasileira, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula signed a decree regulating the Legal Framework for the Electronic Games Industry, emphasizing its importance for Brazilian creativity and innovation. The legislation provides tax incentives, creates the Game Brasil platform, and establishes child protection mechanisms.

item.title: Crusoé: Flaviômetro mobiliza bolsonaristas via constrangimento
item.description: The Flaviometer, an online tool designed to encourage public support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, managed to double the volume of favorable mentions on the internet. Before its launch, right-wing politicians posted between 654 and 916 pro-Bolsonaro messages per day; after the tool’s release, positive engagement increased significantly. The strategy appears to leverage social discomfort to mobilize declared supporters.

item.title: Lula regulamenta Marco dos Games para incentivar indústria de jogos no país
item.description: President Lula signed a decree regulating the Legal Framework for the Brazilian Electronic Games Industry, created in 2024, outlining guidelines to boost local production, train professionals, and export Brazilian games. The decree also creates the public platform Game Brasil and includes user protection, preservation of publicly funded games, and measures against digital violence toward women.

item.title: Agenda de Flávio em MG tem atos no interior e motociata em BH; veja locais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) announced his campaign schedule in Minas Gerais, including events in Capelinha, Nanuque, and a motorcycle parade in Belo Horizonte on October 24, the day before the runoff election. The updated agenda replaces Araçuaí with Capelinha and removes Juiz de Fora compared to earlier announcements. Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) is leading the mobilization of supporters for the events.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: Senado vota proposta nesta quarta-feira; acompanhe em tempo real
item.description: The Brazilian Senate will vote on Wednesday (10/14) a proposal to end the 6x1 scale of the Income Tax, one of the main campaign pledges of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The measure, which simplifies the tax system by reducing the number of income tax rates from six to one, moves forward after Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) declared support for the text, gathering backing from lawmakers across different parties for the first round of voting.

item.title: Meta AI se recusa a fazer material eleitoral para Lula, mas cria para Flávio
item.description: Meta AI, an AI tool by Meta on WhatsApp, refuses to create campaign materials for President Lula (PT) but complies with similar requests for Flávio Bolsonaro. The inconsistency in the company's policy application raises concerns about potential biases in electoral content generation.

item.title: Tarcísio diz a empresários que Flávio será ‘maior do que o pai’
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas claimed that Flávio Bolsonaro will be greater than his father, Jair Bolsonaro, at a business event, criticizing President Lula and calling for support at a downtown São Paulo rally. Flávio emphasized plans to reduce bureaucracy and denied intentions to cut social programs.

item.title: FLÁVIO BOLSONARO: NÃO TEM "CLIMA" DE JÁ GANHOU - JORNAL DA OESTE PRIMEIRA EDIÇÃO - 14/10/2026
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is portrayed as a candidate without a guaranteed victory climate, facing a competitive electoral scenario in 2026. The content analyzes his political trajectory after leaving the presidency and how it may impact his positioning for the elections. The narrative questions the assumption of an immediate win for the former minister.

item.title: Assinatura digital: até a IA indica certificadora que não emite mais.
item.description: Serasa Experian stopped issuing digital certificates in February 2024, but ChatGPT still recommended the company among the best certifiers in September 2026 due to outdated information. The increasing use of digital certificates in Brazil, with over 15 million active copies, requires users to check the official ITI list and verify the credentials of companies before purchasing the service. Alvo Certificado Digital, a registered Authority, emphasizes the importance of validating the issuer's identity and warns against sharing passwords or files through insecure channels.

item.title: Deputados apagam fake news sobre Satanás em ato de Lula na Paulista
item.description: Federal deputies from PL, Zé Trovão and Paulo Bilinskyj, posted and then deleted a manipulated video falsely accusing Lula of invoking Satan during a rally on Paulista Avenue. Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting an injunction to remove the content and fine those involved, claiming the video aimed to inflame religious voters and discredit the candidacy.

item.title: Quando vai ser a votação do fim da escala 6x1?
item.description: The Brazilian Senate will vote on Wednesday on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing weekly hours from 44 to 40 without salary cuts, in the first round, with possible second round the same day. The vote takes place 11 days before the presidential election runoff and is seen as a political win for President Lula, especially following Flávio Bolsonaro's reaction, who initially criticized the proposal before declaring support.
